moon.hero_subtitle: A factory that builds itself. An industry that starts with 10 tons and grows exponentially.
moon.constraint_title: You Cannot Ship a Factory to the Moon
moon.constraint_body: Earth-Moon transport capacity is fundamentally limited. Every kilogram costs a fortune. You cannot launch blast furnaces, rolling mills, or assembly lines. The traditional model of industry — ship the machines, then run them — breaks down at the first Lagrange point.
moon.seed_body: We send not a factory, but a seed. A few tons of the absolute minimum equipment — precision instruments, advanced chip coatings, a laser receiver. Everything else must be grown from lunar soil, powered by laser energy beamed from Earth. The seed is the smallest set of tools that can bootstrap an industrial civilization on another world.
moon.seed_callout: Think of it as a compiler that compiles itself — the industrial equivalent of a self-hosting language.
moon.growth_step_1_desc: The seed package lands on the lunar surface. Solar panels unfold. The laser receiver aligns with Earth.
moon.growth_step_2_desc: Autonomous rovers harvest lunar regolith. The seed's chemical processors separate silicon, iron, aluminum, titanium, and oxygen from the soil.
moon.growth_step_3_desc: Using special solvents — not molten metal — the first structural components crystallize from solution at ambient lunar temperatures.
moon.growth_step_4_desc: The factory builds more factory. Each generation expands capacity. Within decades, it reaches self-sufficiency.
moon.chemistry_title: New Chemistry for a New World
moon.chemistry_body: Traditional metallurgy — melting, casting, forging — is absurd on the Moon. It requires immense heat, heavy equipment, and atmosphere. Instead, we are developing a novel approach: solvents engineered for the lunar environment that enable materials to grow through organic-style reactions. Carbonyl chemistry. Sol-gel transitions. Electrodeposition in ionic liquids. The factory grows like a crystal, not like a blast furnace.
moon.chemistry_callout: No fire. No smoke. No human hands. Just chemistry and light.
moon.timeline_body: This is not a startup. This is not a five-year plan. The Moon Factory is a multi-generational project — the kind of thing civilizations do, not companies. We are laying the first brick of a cathedral that our grandchildren's grandchildren will complete.
moon.timeline_phase_1_desc: Autonomous desert factory. Mineral contracts and government funding.
moon.timeline_phase_2_desc: Lunar seed deployment. NASA/ESA ISRU contracts.
moon.timeline_phase_3_desc: Self-expanding moon factory. Vacuum semiconductor manufacturing begins.
moon.timeline_phase_4_desc: Moon-based mass driver. Helium-3 mining. Lunar becomes industrial hub.
moon.cta_body: What is the smallest set of tools that can build everything else? If you find that question interesting — as a scientist, an engineer, an investor, or a dreamer — we want to hear from you.
moon.moat_body:
The core question: is there a self-replicating manufacturing paradigm that works without water, without Earth-like temperature, and without atmosphere?

The answer is yes, and the key is molten salt electrochemistry. The FFC Cambridge process — discovered in 2000 — directly reduces lunar regolith in molten CaCl₂ at ~900°C, producing both metals and oxygen simultaneously. The metals feed 3D printers. The 3D printers build more FFC reactors. This is the seed of self-replication.

Alex Ellery (Carleton University, 2016-2025) proved the complete chain. The key gap: no one has yet demonstrated the full non-water self-replication cycle in an integrated system. That is what we aim to do.
moon.moat_callout: We don't ship factories to the Moon. We ship seeds that grow into factories.
moon.desert_body:
Before the Moon, we validate on Earth. The desert is our closest terrestrial analog.

Australia’s Pilbara region already hosts the world’s most advanced autonomous mining operations: Rio Tinto’s 70+ autonomous haul trucks, remote-controlled from 1,500 km away in Perth. Fortescue Metals runs fully autonomous fleets powered by solar and hydrogen.

We don’t start from zero. We stand on the shoulders of a proven industry.
moon.desert_poc_body: Solar sintering + autonomous rover in Pilbara. 2-week unmanned run. Budget: ~$600K.
moon.desert_pilot_body: Full sand-to-structure pipeline. 6-month autonomous run. Budget: ~$18M.
moon.desert_full_body: Scaled production with partial self-replication. Ready for lunar deployment. Budget: ~$120M.
moon.type1_title: From Type 0 to Type I Civilization
moon.type1_body:
Nikolai Kardashev defined a scale: Type 0 civilizations use limited planetary resources. Type I harness the full energy of a planet. The Seed Factory is humanity’s first step from Type 0 to Type I.

This is not human conquest of space. This is intelligence, with agency, taking its first upright steps beyond the planetary womb.
moon.timeline_phase_0_desc: Desert validation. AI computing revenue funds the work.
moon.timeline_phase_5_desc: Autonomous lunar industrial center supporting Mars colonization and beyond.
moon.tech_page_desc: Deep dive into non-water solvent chemistry, FFC Cambridge process, and self-replication research
moon.roadmap_page_desc: Full timeline from desert validation to interstellar civilization

about.hero_title: Symbolic Reasoning, Multi-Physics Simulation & Agentic Intelligence
about.hero_subtitle: Symbol Science builds autonomous, zero-hallucination agentic workbenches that unify LLM reasoning, symbolic computation, and multi-physics simulation tools for engineering R&D.
about.mission_body: Real-world engineering discovery cannot rely on pure LLM text generation. It requires combining symbolic mathematics, multi-physics simulation software (CFD, FEA, FreeFem++, OpenFOAM), and automated visualization tools. We build the deterministic agent orchestration layer that turns complex engineering hypotheses into verifiable R&D execution.
about.founder_buaa: B.Eng. in Aircraft Power Engineering, Beihang University (BUAA)
about.founder_mcgill: M.Eng. in Mechanical Engineering, McGill University
about.founder_bio: Yulin (Julian) Shi holds a Master of Engineering from McGill University (specializing in structural dynamics & numerical simulation) and a Bachelor of Engineering in Aircraft Power Engineering from Beihang University (BUAA). With years of experience as a Senior Software Engineer at Alibaba (Lazada) and Booking.com—specializing in Domain-Driven Design (DDD), microservices, and workflow engine architectures—Julian leads Symbol Science in combining multi-physics simulation tools, symbolic reasoning, and LLM agentic workbenches for engineering R&D.
about.pillar_1_desc: Combining LLM reasoning with symbolic math and formal logic to eliminate hallucinations in engineering & scientific workflows.
about.pillar_2_desc: Automating multi-physics simulation (CFD/FEA), parameter sweeps, and high-dimensional plotting via code-generating agents.
about.pillar_3_desc: Testable, modular tool orchestration connecting literature extraction, simulation execution, and automated report generation.
about.cta_body: Whether you are an industrial R&D lab, an engineering team, or an investor, we welcome collaboration on scientific agent workflows.
